errorCode.description: internal error code that identifies the specific error.Most error codes will be used to generate events in the Windows Event Log on the API server

message.description: a brief error message that can be display for the user

help.description: URL to retrieve the documentation for this error, which will explain the nature of the error in detail, as well as providing troubleshooting and/or resolution steps

exceptionThrown.description: The system exception that was thrown
